note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: generic clause headings, fictional destination labels ('Law X (fictional)', 'Forum Y (fictional)'), never a real country, legal system or court. The two clauses are separate: each clause card has its own plain link to its own plaque; no link is drawn between the clauses or between the plaques; relations are plain (no arrowheads, association not causation), and neither decides the other. No conflict-of-laws or jurisdiction doctrine, no validity, effect, priority or outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities (no ranking between the clauses is shown), actorLabels (no actors), actionProgress and finalState (the hold always shows both routes). traversalOrder is exposed as 'order'. objectLabels are the destination plaque labels (destinations).
